---
title: Cleaning type slugs without solvent
summary: Putty first, brush second.
topic: alignment
---

Filled letters, where the bowl of the e prints as a solid dot, come from ribbon ink packed into the slug face. Press a ball of poster putty onto each slug and peel it away slowly so that it lifts the cake of ink in one piece. Follow with a dry brass brush drawn toward the operator, never sideways, because a sideways stroke drags grit into the segment slots.
